name: Ore no Imouto ga Konna ni Kawaii Wake ga Nai. Happy End
original_name: 俺の妹がこんなに可愛いわけがない。 ハッピーエンド
source: The game further expands on the story of the Oreimo light novel series, giving the player, who takes on the role of Kyousuke Kousaka, the choice to follow the story of his complicated life with his younger sister Kirino and their friends.
translation: 该游戏进一步扩展了《Oreimo》轻小说系列的故事，让扮演高坂恭介的玩家可以选择跟随他的妹妹桐乃和他们的朋友们复杂的生活故事。
